question: Is the design ready to implement? Issue #746: gate the explicit pi-subagents --extension/--skill in internal/cli/pi.go on the package NOT being registered (extend the existing piSpacedockPackageStatus settings.json scan to also set subagentsRegistered), preserving the dev-override. Value AC-1 (no duplicate load when registered) + mechanism AC-2 (flag-selection behavior test), ~+30 net LOC across internal/cli/pi.go + test, no observable semantic change beyond dropping the duplicate load. Stacked on rebased PR 725. Approve to enter implementation in a worktree off the rebased 725 branch.

artifacts.summary: Ideation for issue #746: extend piSpacedockPackageStatus to detect pi-subagents registration in the existing settings.json scan (zero new I/O), gate the explicit --extension/--skill in runPi on !subagentsRegistered, preserve the field through the dev-override fallback. Spike confirmed live (settings.json lists npm:pi-subagents; index.ts re-exports src/extension/index.ts). 2 ACs (value+mechanism) with falsifying-change evidence. Expected surface +25-35 net LOC, 2 files, no semantic change beyond dropping the duplicate load. Alternative (point flag at <pkg>/index.ts) rejected as more fragile.
